description: This file is a controller class within a Human Resource Management system, specifically handling employee picture retrieval and caching logic. It interacts with services to fetch employee picture data and manages HTTP responses, including ETag handling and default image fallback.

classes.name: EmployeePictureController
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests to retrieve employee profile pictures, manages caching with ETags, and provides fallback for missing images.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeePictureService instance used to fetch employee picture data.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method processing the request; retrieves employee picture by employee number, manages caching via ETags, and returns appropriate HTTP responses or default image.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets standard HTTP headers on the response object, including content type, cache control, and privacy directives.
